# LokTube 1.6.0

- Improve **ultrawide-monitor layouts**: video thumbnails no longer stretch to fill a fixed three- or four-column grid. At wide desktop sizes (1600px+), the application fits more columns based on available content width while keeping cards at a reasonable size.
- Apply this consistently across **Subscriptions, Home, Channel, Search, History, Likes, Watch Later and Playlists**. Preserve the existing mobile and normal-desktop layouts.
- Keep the special Home **For you** opening row at three videos on regular desktops, while allowing it to grow to five or more cards on ultrawide screens so thumbnails remain proportional. Later rows use the same adaptive sizing.
- Add end-to-end desktop regression tests at 1180px, 1300px, and 1920px for Home and Subscriptions, including maximum card widths and column counts.
